title: Titanium Headphone Driver Enclosure
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is chosen for Titanium Headphone Driver Enclosure where scratch resistance (hardness 36 HRC) and premium tactile feel differentiate the user experience. Its thermal conductivity (6.7 W/mK) is 85% lower than aluminum, reducing heat transfer to the skin surface in handheld devices. The alpha-beta microstructure enables thin-wall CNC profiling to <0.5mm wall thickness while maintaining structural rigidity under 3-point bending — essential for Premium headphone driver chamber housing. This rationale is driven by premium headphone driver chamber housing and service environment demands.
process: CNC milling HSM 30k RPM for audio hardware geometry

surfaceTreatment: PVD TiAlN coating (2-3um, HV2500 hardness) for scratch resistance and uniform gunmetal aesthetic finish — tailored for premium headphone driver application
inspection: Salt spray ASTM B117 (premium headphone verified)
commonFailures: Wear-through of surface after 5000 insertion cycles - mitigated by PVD TiAlN 3um HV2500 coating — critical for premium headphone driver performance

faq.q: What drop-test performance can I expect from Titanium Headphone Driver Enclosure?
faq.a: Titanium Headphone Driver Enclosure fabricated from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V with 0.8-1.2 mm wall thickness typically survives 1.5 m drop onto concrete (per IEC 60068-2-31) without permanent deformation when designed with ≤0.5 mm edge clearance to internal components. The 830 MPa yield strength provides a 3-5× safety margin over the impact stress for premium headphone driver geometries.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Headphone Driver Enclosure?
faq.a: Each Titanium Headphone Driver Enclosure shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for premium headphone driver.
